cues: Agents that raise the mutation rate are mutagens: physical ones like X rays and ultraviolet, chemical ones like mustard gas, nitrous acid and E M S, and biological ones like transposons.
And here is why mutation matters: it is the only original source of new alleles.
Crossing over only reshuffles what already exists.
Without mutation there is nothing for natural selection to work on, and no evolution.
